product: gloons-site (the Gloons channel's public pages and media host)
kind: frontend: design extracted from the repo

sources.colours: style.css :root (light: bg #fbf8f3, fg #1d1b19, muted #6b645c, accent #e2572b, card #fff, line #e8e1d7) and :root[data-theme=dark] (bg #141317, fg #e6e4df, muted #a9a6a0, card #1c1b20, line #2c2a31)
sources.fonts: style.css body: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; brand and headings at 800. No web font (the PNGs use the render machine's system-ui face). File names are set in the system monospace
sources.logo: logo-120.png (the Gloons mark on a rounded tile, radius 10) + 'Gloons' at 800, as in the header of index.html

added_for_this_readme.accent_text: #f0764c on dark and #b8431d on light: the accent lightened/darkened so that small orange text keeps its contrast (tests/test_theme.py holds the site to the same rule)
added_for_this_readme.numbered_steps: an outlined orange circle with a number, for the three steps of the media path

banner_concept: The site's own page with its two jobs side by side: the four pages (what each is for, and that their URLs are registered) and the media host (a file is committed, Pages serves it, Instagram and Facebook fetch the URL).
diagram_concept: Two lanes into main: the pages through a pull request and CI, the media through the publishing pipeline's commits; GitHub Pages serves both; the media URL path is the accent.
fictional_data: the media file name 3f9c1e07ab52d684.mp4 is invented (same shape as the real names)
